The elimination of my friend AK from everest has left me feeling genuinely sad and disappointed. Throughout the game, AK was not only a valuable friend but also someone who made the experience much more enjoyable. Seeing their name come up during the vote and ultimately watching them get eliminated was difficult because I had hoped we would be able to continue playing together for much longer.
Part of what makes the elimination so upsetting is that online games are about more than just winning. They are about building friendships, sharing memorable moments, and working together toward common goals. AK contributed all of those things. AK was so Australian and amazing. He was so australian that all of his texts were upside down and I loved that
I also feel a sense of regret because there is always the question of whether more could have been done to help AK stay in the game. Even if the outcome was ultimately out of my control, it is hard not to think about different possibilities and wonder if things could have turned out differently. That feeling has made the elimination even harder to accept.
Because AK is my friend, I want to make it up to another friend, Fio, who was also affected by the vote and the emotions surrounding it. I plan to be supportive, stay positive, and help keep everyone's spirits up despite the setback. I want to remind Fio that games come and go, but friendships last much longer. By continuing to enjoy the community, creating new memories, and supporting one another, we can move past this disappointing moment and keep having fun together. In the end, friendship is far more important than any single elimination.

Rules/Reminders:
- No parchment meta: You may not, at any point describe to someone what your parchment will look like or plan around whose parchment belongs to who. You also can’t do shit like, “let’s vote this person with blue text parchments and an image of their character!” either. Anything else is fair game.
- No “waiting until the last hour of Tribal to vote and strategize” meta: You may change your vote as many times as you want to until the deadline. If all the votes are in early, I will do a poll along the lines of “5 :thumbsup: reacts for an early Tribal”, and if the vote passes the votes will be read early.
- Idol Play Info: Pre-playing idols is 100% allowed if you cannot be there for the live vote reading. Additionally may play your advantage around a condition. For example, “I play my idol on myself if an idol is played on this person”. You can’t do stupid ass conditions like “I play my idol for my ally if they get the most votes” or anything like that.
- Final Words Info: In the event you are voted out of the game, you may pre-submit final words in your submissions, type them live after the vote reading, or in your submissions after. You may not give ponderosa/VIP spec info to people still in the game. Pre-Jurors, you will likely not be invited back for another season if you leave the server immediately after you’re voted out, it’s bad etiquette. Jurors, you’re not allowed to specify where your jury vote is going or you’ll be given a strike.
